turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey there, how have things been?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is it rude to ask for the check right after we finish eating?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not at all, especially if the restaurant is busy. A simple, could we get the check when you have a moment, is perfectly polite.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What about splitting the bill between five people?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Tell the server at the start of the meal if you can. It makes things much easier for them at the end.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: In the United States, eighteen to twenty percent is standard. Some places add it automatically for groups of six or more, so check the bill first.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, I didn't know that. Good thing I asked.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It catches a lot of people out. Otherwise you might accidentally tip twice.
